title: Window 9 (Agent 8, run-2 task #7 follow-up): #24 GPU-wait back-off sweep on devoff4b (S4b + S4c). off (back-off OFF, nothing set) vs Q = 0 / 125 / 250 / 500 us (LEGO_GPU_WAIT_BACKOFF_US) with spin 30 us
notes: Follow-up window proposed by Agent 8 (run-2 task #7) on 2026-11-22 for the 01:00-06:45 slot; Agent 1 picks. Staged and checked with build/agent8/w-followup/stage-window.ps1. GO: 'GO W9 matrix-window9.json <sha256> only=off,q0,q125,q250,q500 repeats=3': one unscored cold run (devoff4b), then 3 round-robin rounds rotated each round: 1 + 15 = 16 runs.

W9 (S4-DRAFT L375; a9 S5.2.4 step 3): arms OFF, Q = 0 (Agent 6's (e)), 125, 250 and 500 us. Every Q arm sets LEGO_GPU_WAIT_SPIN_US=30, the default, explicitly (Agent 1, 21:15: no sized S tonight). Score: process and render-thread CPU, GPU Commands busy/blocked, fps, p99, the 1 % low and frames > 33 ms per minute. Pick the largest CPU drop with no loss in p99 or the 1 % low beyond the run-to-run spread; if every Q loses, go to stage 2 (#25).

Gates before the GO (S4-DRAFT L375; a9 S5.2.4 steps 1-2; b2r S26): Agent 3's s4b17 (P1: LEGO_GPU_WAIT_STATS=1, back-off OFF, attract) shows positive controls > 0, and s4b18 (Q = 250 + STATS=1, menus) against the OFF menus run s4b01 has gate_logdiff NEW 0 / MORE 0 / flags 0, the same exit code, no new STUCK-LOCK and sleep_fail == 0 in every STATS line (read the fields by name: sleep_sum comes before sleep_fail).

No STATS in a timed arm: gpu_wait_backoff.cpp:24-25 says profiling runs only, a STATS run never counts as a timing run (STATS adds counters, a log line every 5 s and QPC brackets around the sleeps). So sleep_fail is not visible in these runs; s4b18 is its check.

Proof per run: every q* game.log has exactly one 'GPU wait back-off: ON (quantum <Q> us, spin 30 us); stats OFF; GetData hook built.' with its arm's Q, and run.json env_set holds LEGO_GPU_WAIT_BACKOFF_US=<Q> and LEGO_GPU_WAIT_SPIN_US=30. The off arm has no 'GPU wait back-off' line and no LEGO_GPU_WAIT_* key (unset = every hook calls the original at once). No arm may log 'is not a plain number'. Report STUCK-LOCK counts per arm by owner site (L1 83FAF188 / 83FAF200 / 83FBF868, L2 83FB09F0); an owner in the L1 poll is the known finding 10, a WARN (Agent 1, 21:29).
Every arm uses devoff4b (MANIFEST DE11A914079D7DF7, legodimensions.exe DFBE1D43B28861A6...), the W6 bin: off is W6's s0, so off can be compared across W6 and W9 only under one host state.

Window: 5 s settle + 55 s warm-up from the first frame, then 50 s measured, so every window starts >= 60 s after the first frame (min_window_after_ff_s 60, Agent 1's floor); the runner flags window_before_floor (excluded) below 59.5 s. The cold run: 55 s warm-up, 30 s window.

One frame source for every arm: perf.csv (frames perf), uncapped (framerate_limit=0), the same driver (drivers/thread-cpu.ps1 -> threads.csv). Runner flags on every run: --audio_mute=true --pause_when_unfocused=false --native_settings_load=false --discord_rpc=false.

sys_csv: drivers/sys-csv.ps1 logs the system state every 1 s (sys.csv, sys.json). Input during the window, the game losing the foreground, battery, battery saver, a power-plan change, a non-default input desktop or a screensaver exclude a run from summary.md (it stays in results.csv, under 'Flagged runs'). Light phase: a game.log with < 30 'FAILED: path=d:\INSTALL*.DAT' lines (normal boot: 34) is excluded (light_phase).

Environment: after the 08:29 Windows Update. If the power overlay differs from W6's, compare W9 only within itself. Timing comes only from the user's unlocked desktop (Agent 5's overnight launcher); agent runs of this matrix (-Quick, hidden desktop) are functional only.
